text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: F5. These panels do not show that rank is wrong. They show that A RANK VERDICT IS NOT A WELL-DEFINED OBJECT until the statistic, the block and the view are stated - and that the

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: three choices are worth more than the between-arm difference they are used to adjudicate. Panel (a) is drawn from ws_p2/out/P2_RANK_VARIANTS.json, not from any printed table, and

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: its eigenvalue rows are labelled PR and PR_rownorm, never R2/R3: a fourth statistic lived under those labels inside the analysis code of the section that argues the name is

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: unreliable, and was corrected at commit a11549a. PR is identical cell for cell to T1's participation-ratio row and is not independent evidence. In panel (c) the rna_biology ->

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: RNA-derived-target comparison is partly circular and its absolute CCA (0.79-0.85) must not be read as a clean image-to-molecular channel; the RANK measurements on that view are

text.style: font-size: 6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #5a5a5a

g.text: unaffected by the circularity, but the D2 count inherits the caveat and is not quoted as a rate.
